name: Gathlain Mesmerist (CR 6)
body:
GATHLAIN MESMERIST
CR 6

XP 2,400
Gathlain mesmerist 7
CN Small fey
Init +1; Senses low-light vision; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 13, flat-footed 19 (+4 armor, +1 deflection, +1 Dex, +3 natural, +1 size)
hp 49 (7d8+14)
Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +11

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 40 ft. (poor)
Melee mwk heavy mace +6 (1d6–1)
Special Attacks bold stares (disorientation, susceptibility), hypnotic stare (–2), manifold tricks (2 tricks), mental potency (+1), mesmerist tricks 7/day (false flanker, gift of will, mesmeric mirror, misdirection), painful stare (+3 or +2d6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +11)

1/day—entangle (DC 15), feather step (DC 15)

Mesmerist Spells Known (CL 7th; concentration +11)

3rd (2/day)—charm monster (DC 19), glibness
2nd (4/day)—calm emotions (DC 18), enthrall (DC 18), qualm (DC 18), suggestion (DC 18)
1st (5/day)—command (DC 17), forbid action (DC 17), hideous laughter (DC 17), murderous command (DC 17), paranoia (DC 15)
0 (at will)—detect magic, ghost sound (DC 14), haunted fey aspect, mage hand, touch of fatigue (DC 14), unwitting ally (DC 16)

TACTICS

Before Combat If the npc anticipates combat, he drinks his potion of barkskin.

During Combat the npc uses enchantment and illusion spells in combination with his mesmerist stares to force opponents to protect him or stop fighting altogether. If his spells seem ineffective, he uses his mesmerist tricks to bolster his bodyguards instead.

Morale the npc prefers to survive so he can dupe another group into accepting his selfish influence. When reduced to 15 hp or less, he drinks his potion of invisibility and follows it with his potion of gaseous form in an attempt to escape.

Base Statistics Without the enhancement provided by his potion of barkskin, the npc’s statistics become: AC 18, touch 13, flat-footed 17.

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 12, Con 11, Int 12, Wis 14, Cha 18
Base Atk +5; CMB +3; CMD 15
Feats Great Fortitude, Greater Spell Focus (enchantment), Spell Focus (enchantment), Toughness
Skills Bluff +17, Diplomacy +14, Escape Artist +10, Fly –2, Perception +12, Sense Motive +12, Sleight of Hand +10, Spellcraft +11
Languages Common, Halfling, Sylvan
SQ consummate liar +3, touch treatment 7/day (moderate)
Gear potion of barkskin, potion of gaseous form, potion of invisibility, wand of sow thought (30 charges), masterwork chain shirt, masterwork heavy mace, ring of protection +1, 2 tourmalines (worth 500 gp each), 88 gp
